scope: Explicit immutable archive approval, create-only GitHub branch/Draft PR and read-only uncertain-result reconciliation; bounded M4 slice

checks.environment: Python 3.12.15, existing python:3.12-bookworm image, read-only source, isolated PostgreSQL
Real Chromium, PostgreSQL and API; synthetic local HTTP GitHub service

checks.command: Independent focused transport/backend/UI tests and deterministic patch oracle

properties: Authenticated CSRF-protected two-step preview/approval binds exact immutable artifact, target, base and branch; unknown verification remains unknown.
Duplicate command keys and distinct command keys for the same approval resolve to one durable operation.
Separate private credential worker; public API and ordinary run worker never receive its credential; default disabled.
Dedicated PostgreSQL advisory ownership plus expected-stage updates and durable intents before each remote mutation.
Exact Git parent/tree/blob identity, bounded regular UTF-8 patches, protected path and malformed remote data rejection.
Create-only branch and Draft PR; no ref update, force push, merge or automatic rebase.
Ambiguous effects and restarts reconcile through GET only; verified PR URL derived from target and PR number.
Browser confirms selected historical run, explicit preview/approval, one branch/PR across replay and lost-response read-only recovery.
resolved_failures: Absent export modules/settings and stub UI controls established meaningful red tests before implementation.
Transport rejected nonfinite JSON and malformed Git fields; unrelated existing Unicode/spaced paths were distinguished from changed-path policy.
Backend reason-code constraint and exact PR-number readback assertions initially failed and were corrected.
Independent review found raw TypeError for container-valued tree type/mode and PR state; explicit string checks plus four regressions now pass.
One UI test used getByLabel instead of getByLabelText; corrected test API without changing product assertions.
Initial local verification setup lacked make on PATH and browser child import paths; final checks use existing toolchain and explicit source paths.
Sandbox prevented synthetic loopback transport binding; authorized isolated local rerun passed.
New browser flows exposed old fixture global allocation/prompt counters; counters now select only the original run, retaining the original exact reconnect assertions.
limits: No live product GitHub export, existing credential access, paid provider calls, KVM acceptance, merge or deployment in this slice.
Synthetic GitHub tests are not live GitHub acceptance; hosted CI evidence is recorded separately on the delivery PR and task report.
SHA-1 Git bases only; changed paths use conservative unquoted ASCII names; binary/rename/copy/symlink/submodule/mode-only patches rejected.
32 changed files, 256 KiB patch, 1 MiB file, 4 MiB combined source/output and 8 MiB recursive tree response.
Base may advance after final check; GitHub offers no transaction across base read and PR creation.
Unknown tree/commit effects or branch-only outcomes may remain uncertain and leave remote objects; no automatic cleanup/reset/replacement.
15-second socket timeout and response-loop deadline are not a strict DNS/read wall-clock bound.
Backup/restore/GC, arbitrary artifacts and full M3/M4 completion remain later work; billing stays deferred and costs unknown.
cleanup: Owned PostgreSQL test containers removed; native verification container uses --rm; no live VM allocated.
base_refresh: Unrelated component changes merged before delivery; agent-platform source and applicable instructions unchanged from the verified base.
